annotations.title: Export a backup as a downloadable file

description: Packages a backup into a downloadable archive. Requires a paid account and balance; refused while another upload, export or restore is pending (at most 3 per account). Poll listBackups until exportState is ready, then call getBackupDownloadUrl; if it returns to idle instead, the export failed.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.
